web.description: On some CPUs, like the ESP32-S3, the FPU performs these operations directly in hardware, making them fast and efficient. On others, like the ESP32-C3, floating-point math is executed in software, which is slower but still accurate thanks to standard libraries.

web.title: Speed Optimization - ESP32-C3 - — ESP-IDF Programming Guide v6.0.2 ...
web.description: Avoid using floating point arithmetic float. On ESP32-C3 these calculations are emulated in software and are very slow. If possible, use fixed point representations, a different method of integer representation, or convert part of the calculation to be integer only before switching to floating point.
